survey_scope: 17 targeted source files; not an exhaustive whole-library audit
completion_rule: Exact concrete milestone, matching external cached compiler PASS, exact-type PASS, standard-only theorem axiom audit PASS, auxiliary analytic/certificate/witness/checker/admission obligations discharged
import_rule: remove .lean from path and replace / with .
source_windows_note: Windows identify reviewed source portions, not exact per-declaration spans. All indexed names were inspected at the pin.

sources.guard: Normalized probability Haar measure; complex scalar L2 carrier; weighted/vector/physical bridges remain explicit; uniform series convergence needs summable coefficients.
Summation formula requires positive real exponent; generic lp is not itself the native weighted Sobolev identification.
Nonnegative or positive hypotheses must be supplied; algebra does not certify literature constants.
Continuity and right-derivative premises on the specified intervals; strict boundary fence differs from a globally nonpositive derivative hypothesis.

C1 compactly supported maps on a finite-dimensional normed domain with Haar measure and the stated exponent identity. Periodic fractional Sobolev transfer, tensor norms and C_F comparison are not supplied.
HolderTriple and a.e. measurable pointwise bilinear estimate required; mono_exponent here requires finite measure.
Inspected inequalities have constant K. Not a direct replacement for the integrated time-dependent coefficient budget or the signed dissipative NSE estimate.
A.e. measurability and countable/directness hypotheses where stated. Fatou alone does not give strong convergence or a common solution.
Actual common integrable majorant and a.e. convergence; no such majorant follows merely from weak convergence.
Nonempty compact set and continuous function; apply on a time interval, not an unproved compact infinite-dimensional unit sphere.
DiffContOnCl, full closed-strip boundedness, closed-strip membership and both boundary estimates required.
Compact source, common compact range and equicontinuity. A bounded Hilbert ball is not automatically a compact range.
Continuity, derivative, endpoint/one-sided and integrability hypotheses must match the finite Galerkin path or justified limit.
Finite weighted nonnegative interpolation; no automatic nonlinear convolution bound.
Polynomial differentiation in a normed commutative ring; actual energy derivative supplied separately.
A.e. strong measurability, finite norm integral and nonzero/noninfinite exponent as stated; equality-a.e. representatives must be proved.
Specified interval/halfline integrability is required for additivity and exhaustion identities.

endpoints.remaining: Exact literature/native weighted norms at orders 1/2 and 3/2 on the same mean-zero carrier and measure.
Concrete K2 and Sobolev constants; exact native coefficient and energy/derivative normalization. No extra native sqrt(2) by renaming.
Concrete periodic scalar/vector/tensor bounds and combined coefficient <= C_F. Library constants not identified with literature constants.
Supply E03 finite differential inequality and initial cutoff bound at C_F.
Frontier gap and actual finite-path integration; preserve factor two.
Frontier specialization, factor four and retained terminal energy.
Actual RHS decomposition plus E04/E05; separate D_* and frontier denominator.
Insert frontier quartic budget; retain integrated time-dependent coefficient method.
Actual Fourier H2 identity and frontier accumulation constant.
E09 seed plus existing genuine high-order NSE estimate; positive time only.
Same subsequence and actual derivative representative; domination only where separately proved.
Joint terminal-energy/Fatou bound for the same limit and frontier gap.
One actual solution satisfying every frontier quantitative and physical field; no library-only NSE closure claimed.
Exact smallness conversion and E13 application, preserving carrier and conclusion.
